notes.title: Rainbow Run Free Expansion Pack Is Here!
notes.content:
The Rainbow Run Free Expansion Pack is officially released on Steam! You can check it out here: Free Expansion Pack Store Link

The Rainbow Run Expansion breathes new life into Rainbow Run's base game. It provides players with access to an extra 10 levels, all scaling in difficulty, for players to complete. This update doesn't only include new levels. It also includes drastic changes to the entire base game, including a massive difficulty nerf!

If you wish to contact me for any reason, see the links below:

► Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsWaxsFbLMXszFg971Pgfww
► Email: crgamesdirect@gmail.com

Check out ALL of the new features here:

[NEW CONTENT]
- Added the free expansion pack! See the section titled "free expansion pack".
- Majorly nerfed the difficulty of most levels. See the section titled "difficulty nerf".
- Added 10 new levels.
- Added 4 new cubes with new effects.
- Reworked pause menu, win UI, lose UI, and main UI to display everything in a cleaner way.
- Allowed total deaths to be visible while playing (and not just on the death and win screen).
- Added footsteps and jumping sounds.
- Changed main menu sound effects.
- Added new artwork to Steam Page, Steam Client, and more.

[FREE EXPANSION PACK]
The Rainbow Run free expansion pack is here! Here's a list of all of the new features:
- Added new block "Physics Block": Blocks that players can pick up and move around!
- Added new block "Gravity Block": Touching this block gives the player zero gravity, and touching it again returns to normal gravity.
- Added new block "Fade Block": Touching this block reveals hidden platforms around the level that are ONLY visible when touching the fade block.
- Added new block "Swap Block": This block switches between two different blocks every 'x' seconds.
- Added 10 brand new levels, scaling in difficulty. These levels are available immediately regardless of your progress in the regular game.
- New levels: "Fade Blocks", "Swap Blocks", "Physics Blocks", "Gravity Blocks", "Ancient Temple", "Symmetry", "Assumptions", "Lunar Walkway", "Brain Twister", "The Finale".
- All new levels have new unique soundtracks.
- All new levels scale in difficulty similar to the base game. However, some of the new levels focus more on critical thinking instead of parkour.
- The expansion pack brings a major difficulty nerf to the base game, as many levels were too difficult. See section titled "difficulty nerf" below.

[BUG FIXES]
Fixed a UI element blocking one of the play buttons.
On Level 8, fixed a bug where using the top block to teleport would occasionally teleport you into a red cube.
On Level 16, fixed incorrectly alligned lights.
On Level 19, fixed a piece of stone wall sticking out in the wrong location.
Throughout various levels, fixed instances of red cube colliders having incorrect sizes.

[DIFFICULTY NERF]
Level 8:
Removed red block near first jump block, making crossing a lot easier.
Removed a coin near the first jump block, making the level significantly easier.
Added break blocks across the top of the level to make returning back easier.
Level 9:
Removed entire second layer of slug blocks, drastically reducing difficulty.
Removed coin at the second layer of slug blocks, reducing difficulty.
Moved all break blocks and moving red blocks closer to each other to drastically reduce difficulty.
Level 10:
Removed 4 caution blocks on first layer of tower.
Removed spinning platform with coin to reduce difficulty.
Removed entire top layer to reduce difficulty.
Removed 4 caution blocks on the top layer of the tower.
Level 12:
Removed long moving red block at the top of the level when crossing to green block.
Removed all down blocks to drastically reduce difficulty.
Level 13:
Removed two red blocks at the end of the level above the green cube.
Removed two moving red blocks and replaced them with static red blocks to reduce difficulty.
Removed 2 coins and their entire pathways to drastically reduce difficulty.
Level 14:
Removed 9 red blocks at the farthest point in the level to drastically reduce difficulty.
Removed 1 red block near the top block to reduce difficulty.
Removed 2 coins to reduce difficulty.
Completely removed fast-moving section towards the end of the level to reduce difficulty.
Level 15:
Removed a slug block to reduce difficulty when jumping over moving red block.

notes.title: Rainbow Run Update!
notes.content:
[BUG FIXES]
- Fixed a bug where the UI would not properly scale to certain resolutions.
- Fixed multiple off-centered cubes on Level 16.

[CHANGES]
On Level 8, moved a difficult coin to an easier location.
On Level 9, removed a fast-moving red block to make the pathway to a coin easier.
On Level 10, removed 4 fast-moving red blocks to make pathways to coins easier.
On Level 13, removed 2 red cubes to improve timings.
On Level 20, added lights for visibility to drastically reduce difficulty.

[NEW CONTENT]
The Rainbow Run "FREE Expansion Pack" is being worked on. Anyone who owns the game will be able
to download it and play it for free!

The expansion pack will contain an extra 10 levels that scale in difficulty. These levels will
feature a completely new set of cubes with new effects. It will be a whole new experience from
the original game!

The release date for the expansion pack has not yet been set.
